title: Nine Radio Stations, One Showroom, One Unforgettable LEPAS Celebration
excerpt: All nine Arabian Radio Network stations broadcast live from the LEPAS Deira showroom, with test drives, a family day in Hatta and a brand new L4 for one lucky listener.
body: Following the opening of the LEPAS showroom in Deira, Al Ghurair Mobility set out to introduce the brand to the country in a way that matched its ambition. As the exclusive UAE dealer for LEPAS, the aim was to let the wider public experience firsthand a brand built on the "Leopard Aesthetics" design philosophy and its proposition of Drive Your Elegance. To do exactly that, Al Ghurair Mobility partnered with the Arabian Radio Network and turned the showroom into the heart of a citywide celebration.

Across the campaign, all nine ARN stations broadcast their live shows directly from the LEPAS showroom. Virgin Radio 104.4, Hit FM 96.7, Dubai Eye 103.8, Dubai 92, City 101.6 FM, Tag 91.1 FM, Al Arabiya 99 FM, Al Khaleejiya 100.9 FM and Radio Shoma 93.4 FM all invited their listeners to come down and experience the brand for themselves. Visitors were welcomed onto the showroom floor to explore the L8 and the L4 up close, sit behind the wheel, and take both models out on the road for a test drive. Every guest was also invited to register for the chance to win a brand new LEPAS L4 of their own.

The celebration then extended well beyond the showroom. Twenty of the most enthusiastic listeners were selected to join the RJs from all nine stations for a family day out in Hatta, filled with activities, entertainment and prizes for everyone who attended. The journey continued to Jebel Ali for a gala dinner, where the grand prize was awarded and the campaign reached its high point. A loyal listener of Tag 91.1 FM took home the keys to a brand new LEPAS L4, driving away in a car of their very own.

The activation brought LEPAS to thousands of people across the emirate and gave the brand a debut worthy of its arrival. As LEPAS settles into its new home with Al Ghurair Mobility, this is one more milestone, and there is much still to come.

title: A New Home for LEPAS: Deira Showroom Now Open
excerpt: The LEPAS showroom in Deira opened on 29 August, giving UAE customers a dedicated space to explore the L8 and L4 alongside the existing Al Quoz facility.
body: The LEPAS showroom in Deira is officially open, a milestone in Al Ghurair Mobility's expansion and its commitment to bringing world-class automotive experiences closer to customers across the UAE.

The showroom opened its doors on 29 August, welcoming visitors to explore the LEPAS lineup for the first time in the country. As the exclusive UAE dealer for LEPAS, Al Ghurair Mobility now offers customers a dedicated space to discover a brand that is redefining what premium mobility looks like, built on the "Leopard Aesthetics" design philosophy and guided by the proposition of Drive Your Elegance.

Currently on the showroom floor, customers can explore the L8 and the L4, two models that capture the breadth and ambition of the LEPAS range. The Deira location sits alongside the existing Al Quoz facility, giving customers across the emirate convenient access to the brand.

There is much to look forward to. The L6 and L9 are expected to join the showroom floor soon, completing the lineup and giving customers an even fuller picture of what the brand has to offer. A Sharjah showroom is also on the horizon, extending the network further and bringing LEPAS closer to even more customers across the emirates.
imageLabel: A New Home for LEPAS: Deira Showroom Now Open
